invariants.description: c^2 + s^2 stays within 1e-6 of c_init^2 + s_init^2
elastance between E_min and s_heart E_max (to 1e-6 of the range: the solver lets c leave [-1, 1] by its local error)
invariants.expr: (np.min(E) >= min(E_min, s_heart*E_max) - 1e-6*abs(s_heart*E_max - E_min)) & (np.max(E) <= max(E_min, s_heart*E_max) + 1e-6*abs(s_heart*E_max - E_min))

invariants.description: volume balance: q - q_init equals the integral of v_in - v_out (trapezoid)
invariants.expr: abs((q[-1] - q[0]) - np.trapezoid(v_in - v_out, t)) <= 1e-3*np.trapezoid(np.abs(v_in) + np.abs(v_out), t) + 1e-12

invariants.description: backflow through each valve over the last beat is under 1% of its forward flow
invariants.expr: (-np.trapezoid(np.minimum(v_out, 0)[t >= t[-1] - 1/f], t[t >= t[-1] - 1/f]) <= 0.01*np.trapezoid(np.maximum(v_out, 0)[t >= t[-1] - 1/f], t[t >= t[-1] - 1/f]) + 1e-12) & (-np.trapezoid(np.minimum(v_in, 0)[t >= t[-1] - 1/f], t[t >= t[-1] - 1/f]) <= 0.01*np.trapezoid(np.maximum(v_in, 0)[t >= t[-1] - 1/f], t[t >= t[-1] - 1/f]) + 1e-12)

bc_sweep.rationale: f 30-180 bpm; inlet 1-20 mmHg; outlet 38-150 mmHg; strength 0.25-2x; valve slope from smooth (0.02/Pa) to sharp (1/Pa). The initial phase stays on the unit circle.

baseline.reason: no data: a synthetic module of the known-structure test model (ICUHealthy models/simple)

calibrate.note: not_applicable: no data to calibrate against
